executionSequence: Tenere un appoggio stabile e sollevare un piede di circa 5 cm.
Completare circonduzioni della caviglia; la freccia circolare rappresenta l’intero ciclo.
Riappoggiare il piede e ripetere dall’altro lato.

independentReview.reason: Freccia orizzontale attorno alla tibia suggerisce rotazione della gamba; serve traiettoria circolare del piede centrata sulla caviglia.

previousPhases.description: In piedi con appoggio stabile e piede leggermente sollevato; freccia indica la circonduzione della caviglia. Ripetere dall'altro lato.
previousPhases.prompt: Create ONE realistic fitness illustration PNG landscape 3:2, ivory background floor soft shadows, no captions numbers panels. Original attached Misurami identity is authoritative: same adult man curly dark hair beard athletic proportions, charcoal T-shirt original small yellow/white Misurami logo on anatomical LEFT chest, charcoal shorts with thin yellow sides, black shoes. Exercise ANKLE CIRCLES: standing upright in slight frontal three-quarter view, left foot firmly planted, right foot lifted about 5 centimeters above floor in front without bending entire leg much; right ankle gently pointed and turned slightly inward as part of circumduction. Left hand gently holds a stable freestanding gym rack upright with wide grounded base at left side of frame, right arm relaxed. Add ONE small thin yellow circular arrow adjacent to the raised right shoe to indicate ankle rotation; arrow does not obscure anatomy. Knee and thigh remain stable, movement at ankle, natural correct limbs hands and grip. Entire body, both shoes, complete support visible with generous margins. No other equipment.

rootReview.scope: Every selected PNG visually checked after independent review; professional trainer review not performed.
